manifest.name: Alphabet Textures
manifest.description: 26 ready-to-use letter textures (A-Z), one Stride Texture asset per glyph.

manifest.name: Stride Avalonia UI
manifest.description: Render Avalonia UI inside Stride: fullscreen HUDs and world-space panels drawn by headless Skia, uploaded to GPU textures with near-zero per-frame allocations. Full mouse/keyboard forwarding, texture atlas for world panels, widget host, live metrics overlay.

manifest.name: Stride Dependency Injection
manifest.description: Lightweight dependency injection for Stride ScriptComponents: register your types, mark public get/set properties with [Inject], and the library wires them up automatically.

manifest.name: Stride GPU Grass System
manifest.description: GPU-driven grass: one compute dispatch builds and LOD-culls hundreds of thousands of animated blades from seed points. Procedural shading (no textures), world-space wind, and a scrolling trample field that flattens a trail under the player. Decoupled from any terrain.

manifest.name: Stride Marching Cubes Voxel Terrain
manifest.description: GPU Marching Cubes voxel terrain: fill chunks with one of three noise generators (Perlin hills, ridged mountains, 3D caves), mesh them on the GPU with smooth gradient normals, and shade with a triplanar multi-material blend. Drop in the VoxelTerrain component and get a map.

manifest.name: Number Textures
manifest.description: 10 ready-to-use digit textures (0-9), one Stride Texture asset per glyph.

manifest.name: Placeholder Textures
manifest.description: Fallback/debug textures for prototyping — Missing, Error, Undefined, checker, UV grid, flat normal and solids.

manifest.name: Stride Procedural Sky & Day/Night
manifest.description: A fully procedural sky on a camera-following dome: gradient, sun disc + halo, a textured moon with phases, drifting clouds, twinkling stars and a sunset glow. A built-in day/night clock rotates the sun and moon and drives a directional light. No textures or cubemaps.
